title: Afternoon Program Quality Judge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Judge six fictional afternoon programs as structured, partly structured, or unstructured by counting the SAFE practices each one includes.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge whether each of six afternoon programs is structured, partly structured, or unstructured by applying the SAFE practices, correctly judging at least five of six on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Structured afternoon, unstructured afternoon drift, afternoon program quality, and the SAFE practices, from the section "Structure Versus Drift" in Chapter 14

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, get feedback with the reason, and review what was missed
keyQuestions: Which of the four SAFE practices does the description include?
commonMisconceptions: A program with a trained adult is structured
assessmentOpportunities: A program has a trained adult, hands-on work, and nothing else. Rating?
Does a supervised program have quality?
A program has Sequenced, Active, and Explicit but no Focused component. Rating?

controls.name: Choice buttons
controls.description: commit an answer. A wrong first answer gives a hint and lets you choose again; only the first answer counts.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: opens or closes the reference table. Reading it is exploration, not evidence.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves to the next item after feedback. On the results screen, Previous missed and Next missed step through what you missed.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: starts a practice run with the items reshuffled. Practice runs do not change the first-run score.
